name: Modern Controls
author: Taurus0815
description: Modern Controls: responsive movement, fixed 3x original ammo limits, 10x bolts, 10x Thruster-Pack glide and press R1 once free flight. Original HUD and menus retained.

settings.name: Responsive movement
settings.description: Faster acceleration and braking while grounded. Does not replace camera or strafe aiming.

settings.name: Toggle movement key
settings.description: Toggle the movement response without changing launcher bindings.

settings.name: Aim + melee: wrench throw
settings.description: Hold the launcher-mapped Aim action and press Square/X to perform the native Comet Strike.

settings.name: Normal wrench swing speed
settings.description: Grounded swings only; damage is unchanged.

settings.name: Overhead wrench speed
settings.description: Jump + wrench animation speed; preserves native landing physics.

settings.name: Overhead crate radius (m)
settings.description: Extra crate wave when the overhead strike lands.

settings.name: Overhead enemy radius (m)
settings.description: Native wrench damage to nearby enemies on ground impact.

settings.name: Bolt attraction radius
settings.description: Multiplier for native bolt magnet distance and height.

settings.name: Extra health
settings.description: Two ordinary damage hits remove one Nanotech orb. Instant-kill falls and crushers still work normally.

settings.name: Ammo capacity multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier of each weapon's original ammo limit.

settings.name: Ammo shop price multiplier
settings.description: Vendor ammo price as a fraction of the original price.
Planar speed multiplier while gliding with the worn Thruster-Pack.
settings.name: Thruster-Pack glide speed

settings.description: While gliding, press R1 once to toggle flight. Hold Jump to ascend and L1 to descend. Requires flight support.
settings.name: Press R1 to toggle free flight
